examples.title: Business performance
examples.audience: Business owner monitoring and investigating performance
examples.decision: How is performance changing, and which segments and accounts contribute?
examples.cadence: Any supported period; review cadence does not determine layout
examples.composition: Five-tab executive overview, revenue and economics, adoption, retention, and customer deep dives; adapt to available evidence
examples.grain: Comparable dated observations; entity-level rows only for entity exploration
interactions: Independent tab scope with native normal-to-sticky filters and prior-period comparison
Tab-wide time interval with coverage-aware choices
Cohort table with maturity gaps and explicit customer drill-down
Compact outcome-and-trend cards with source-backed prior series
optionalEvidence: Serving costs, user identities and seat entitlements

examples.title: Infrastructure capacity
examples.decision: Where is serving capacity constrained, and which region or pool explains pressure?
examples.grain: Half-hour × region × environment × accelerator pool; incident rows are separate.
requiredEvidence: Capacity, unavailable capacity and demand with common units
Queue depth and valid delay distributions
badFit: SLO percentiles from subgroup percentiles alone
examples.composition: Dense operating panel combining regional small multiples, compact capacity signals and an incident queue; a full-width trend supplies historical context. See content/dashboard/DashboardContent.jsx and example.css for the composition, not just chart specs.

examples.title: Fleet operations
examples.decision: Are deliveries on track, and how do operating cost and cash affect the business?
examples.grain: Route × day records and weekly × region rollups; invoice records and modeled intraday curves are separate.
requiredEvidence: Explicit intraday observations or clearly labeled modeled inputs for an intraday view
badFit: Claimed daily observations derived only by dividing weekly aggregates
optionalEvidence: Route/customer IDs for route detail and customer-invoice exploration
examples.composition: Custom borderless operating sections: delivery snapshot and planned-versus-actual progress, cost investigation, then a cash-collection ledger. Daily and weekly controls have distinct scopes; do not convert every block into equal cards.

examples.title: Stock watch
examples.decision: How has a selected security traded, and what do price, volume and scenarios show?
examples.grain: Daily × ticker OHLC and volume; scenario assumptions are separate from observations.
requiredEvidence: Valid ordered OHLC bars and volume
Separate scenario assumptions and synthetic disclosure
badFit: Audited real market evidence from this synthetic fixture
Treating scenario projections as observed returns
examples.composition: Entity-first workspace with an independently scrolling watchlist, a capped price/volume center, and intrinsic-height supporting rail cards; authored viewport layout becomes a mobile watchlist strip. Read content/dashboard/example.css alongside DashboardContent.jsx.

examples.title: Acme Cloud automation usage
examples.decision: Where does adoption move from installation to activation, repeat usage and retention?
examples.grain: Dated aggregate counts/rates, separate cohorts, and aggregate conversation flows.
requiredEvidence: Numerators and denominators for combined rates
Cohort observation cutoff and deduplicated flow population
examples.composition: Long lifecycle exploration with section navigation and locally editable chart groups: installs, activation, first-use flow, activity and retention. State, section grouping and responsive canvas layout live together in content/dashboard/DashboardContent.jsx.

examples.title: Lattice product growth
examples.decision: Are new workspaces activating, returning, and using deeper features—and which workspaces explain the gaps?
examples.grain: Workspace registry and complete workspace-week activity; eligibility and mature signup cohorts are explicit.
requiredEvidence: Stable workspace identities and dated creation
Feature eligibility and a known observation cutoff
Dated feedback records and recorded roadmap dispositions for the optional feedback flow
goodFit: Product growth and depth of adoption
badFit: Roadmap delivery or project issue tracking
Causal experiment claims from launch timing alone
examples.composition: Three investigation tabs with a combined selectable metric-and-trend opening, linked feature/workspace matrix, flow investigation and cohort drill-down; not a row of independent KPI cards. Read the controlled state and layout as well as each chart spec.
